purpose: Deterministic regression set for the Current Graph RAG projection. Cases assert governed node/ERA/Feature reachability and provenance, not generative wording or historical numbered LOC ownership.

cases.note: Current self-governance concept should stay anchored in the current self-governance ERA and relevant governed domains.
Luna Codex naming-history query should recover the recorded milestone and align with the current LOC-start ERA authority.
Moon Speaker milestone should connect the narrative work history to the current Moon Speaker/LunaRunes ERA authority.

Direct current ERA query should stay on the governed temporal backbone.
Naming-origin lookup must not collapse onto the current self-governance ERA.

governance: Evaluation cases assert graph structure and provenance only; they do not promote semantic similarity into canonical edges.
Feature expectations describe reusable Current capabilities and never imply ownership.
Historical LOC1–8 routing is not a valid Current evaluation dimension.
A case may be updated only when the upstream governed source/event/ERA evidence changes.
Private live relation rows must never be required by the public evaluation set.
